engine_titles.geo-shapes.js: Circles and shapes on the map

engine_descriptions.geo-core.js: The one haversine: distance and bearing between two points, with the three named earth radii (atlas, UK, mean). Every other copy of distanceKm should import from here.
engine_descriptions.geo-area.js: Area of a polygon, perimeter of a line, area of a circle cap, in square kilometres.
engine_descriptions.geo-shapes.js: Points around a circle on the earth, for drawing search radii and zones.
engine_descriptions.geo-geojson.js: Reading and writing GeoJSON features without losing coordinates.
engine_descriptions.v9-geodesy.js: The geodesy copy carried by the v9 atlas cartridges, byte-identical to the engine's.
engine_descriptions.v9-nearest-search.js: Finds the nearest substations and lines to a point, the search the atlas runs on every click.
engine_descriptions.network-topology.js: Which substations connect to which lines, as a graph.
engine_descriptions.electrical-distance.js: Distance along the network rather than as the crow flies.
engine_descriptions.rating-envelope.js: How much a line or transformer can carry, by season.
engine_descriptions.published-fault-level.js: Fault level as each network operator publishes it; never calculated here.
engine_descriptions.voltage-drop.js: Voltage lost along a cable for a given load.
engine_descriptions.corridor-estimate.js: Length and cost of a cable corridor from a site to a connection point.
engine_descriptions.electrification-demand.js: Demand added when heat and transport go electric.
engine_descriptions.firm-capacity.js: Capacity that can be relied on after the largest single loss.
engine_descriptions.diversified-demand.js: Demand after allowing for loads that do not peak together.
engine_descriptions.connection-capacity.js: Whether a site can connect and how much, from the ratings and the demand.
engine_descriptions.route-obstacles.js: Roads, rails, rivers and buildings a route must cross.
engine_descriptions.interconnector-economics.js: Value of moving power between markets.
